profile_text.body:
AeroVironment, which refers to itself as AV, describes itself as a leading manufacturer of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Loitering Munition Systems, and Unmanned Ground Vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States Military, U.S. allies and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites.

MacCready Works is described as AV's advanced development group, which the company says turns concepts into mission-ready autonomous systems at speed. It says the group is inspired by Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr., and that its engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers design next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea. The company describes a MacCready Method of build fast, test relentlessly, deploy advantage, with small multidisciplinary teams moving ideas into operational capability in months.

AeroVironment is a public company traded under the ticker AVAV, headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, with CIK 0001368622. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Virginia, with 145 cases.
